learning_outcomes.text: The student will acquire the knowledge to design electronic circuits.
Student will know how to design the circuit and how to create this circuit.

syllabus_topics: Design, connection, and measurement of RC circuits.
Types of rectifiers and their characteristics (single-phase rectifiers).
Types of rectifiers and their characteristics (full-wave rectifiers).
Stabilization of rectified voltage (parametric stabilizer, feedback stabilizer).
Properties of bipolar transistors (NPN, PNP) and BJT configurations in circuits (common emitter, common base, common collector).
Properties of unipolar transistors (J-FET, MOSFET, etc.).
Properties of operational amplifier circuits (voltage follower, non-inverting amplifier).
Properties of operational amplifier circuits (comparator, inverting amplifier).
Properties and configurations of switching components.
Design and implementation of active filters.
assessment_rules: Credit conditions require the student to have measured all protocols and to have been absent less than thrice. The exam involves consultation of the protocols and answering questions about measurements. In case of distance learning, lessons via MS Teams are equivalent to participation and attendance.
